//: Typechecks `nts.config.ts` against the real @nts/config, separately from the program. Named tsconfig.config.json and not tsconfig.json for the reason stated in examples/workspace: the gate globs every tsconfig.json one level under examples/, and a second one here would enrol this fixture twice.
//why: Separate rather than merged. The config is evaluated by node at build-planning time and the program is compiled by nts; putting both in one project made the compiler lower the build system into the artifact. Two projects is the honest shape, and `tooling/config/audit.mjs` fails if a config is enrolled in neither.
